CREATE TABLE users (

	login VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	login_normalized VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	password_hash LONGTEXT NOT NULL, 
	display_name VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	theme VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'light', 
	auth_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, 
	`role` VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'user', 
	enabled BOOL NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, 
	last_login_at DATETIME(6), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_users_77e1b1e1 CHECK (role IN ('user','admin')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_users_7fd8ad15 CHECK (theme IN ('light','dark')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_users_c8d8b288 CHECK (REGEXP_LIKE(login_normalized, '^[a-z0-9_]{3,32}$', 'c')),

	CONSTRAINT ck_users_auth_version CHECK (auth_version > 0)

	CONSTRAINT ck_platform_configs_eade69e6 CHECK (kind IN ('model','prompt','skill','mcp','limits')),

CREATE TRIGGER guard_generation_transition BEFORE UPDATE ON vector_generations FOR EACH ROW BEGIN IF OLD.state='retired' AND NEW.state<>'retired' OR OLD.state='active' AND NEW.state='staging' THEN SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MESSAGE_TEXT='retired generation cannot reactivate'; END IF; END
